'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Jonny Chu DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet '''Jenny Chu''' / deck '''Need More Curry!'''; dest [[Jonny Chu]]. Opens on Kessel; [[Spice Mine Operations]] mid-list.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kessel]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
